parsed.executive_summary: Blinkit faces a severe trust crisis driven by late deliveries, unresponsive customer support, and product quality issues, with 17.2% of users explicitly citing delays and 37.6% complaining about support — this is eroding the core '10-minute delivery' promise and pushing users toward Swiggy Instamart.

sentiment_trajectory.insight: Sentiment is declining sharply due to repeated failures in delivery timing, support responsiveness, and product quality, with many users explicitly comparing Blinkit unfavorably to Swiggy Instamart.

psychographic_segments.how_to_win_them: fix the refund and return process to be instant and hassle-free, and provide a direct helpline number
ensure delivery times are consistently under 10 minutes and communicate delays proactively
offer transparent pricing with no hidden surge charges and a loyalty program that discounts delivery fees

high_risk_signals.retention_action: implement real-time delivery tracking with proactive delay alerts and compensation
introduce a live chat with human agents and a direct phone support line
enforce strict quality checks at warehouses and allow instant returns for damaged/expired items

language_intelligence.regional_insight: North Indian Hinglish users express the most extreme anger with phrases like 'sabse ghatiya' and 'bakwas', while Tamil users are more neutral but still flag location tracking bugs — indicating that the core frustration is concentrated in the Hindi belt but technical issues are pan-India.
